name: arabic-tah
draw: Arabic letter tah (ط): a flat closed loop lying on the line with a tall straight stroke rising from its left end.

name: arabic-zah
draw: Arabic letter zah (ظ): the tah shape of a flat loop and tall upright stroke, with one dot above the loop.

name: arabic-ghayn
draw: Arabic letter ghayn (غ): a small open c shaped head on a large open curve that sweeps down and around below the line, with one dot above.

name: arabic-fa
draw: Arabic letter fa (ف): a small round loop on the right end of a long flat stroke that curls up at the left, with one dot above the loop.

name: arabic-qaf
draw: Arabic letter qaf (ق): a small round loop on top of a deep round bowl sweeping below the line, with two dots above.

name: arabic-kaf
draw: Arabic letter kaf (ك): a tall upright stroke on the left joined to a flat base that curls up at the right, with a small s like squiggle inside.

name: arabic-lam
draw: Arabic letter lam (ل): a tall straight stroke that curves at its foot into a deep round bowl rising back up on the left.

name: arabic-mim
draw: Arabic letter mim (م): a small closed round loop on the line with a straight tail dropping down beneath it.

name: arabic-nun
draw: Arabic letter nun (ن): a deep round open bowl like a cup with one dot above its centre.

name: arabic-heh
draw: Arabic letter heh (ه): a small rounded teardrop loop with a smaller loop folded inside it.

name: arabic-waw
draw: Arabic letter waw (و): a small round head loop with a tail curving down and to the left below the line.

name: arabic-ya
draw: Arabic letter ya (ي): a small curl at the top right dropping into a wide bowl that sweeps back to the right under the line, with two dots below.

name: arabic-alif-maqsura
draw: Arabic letter alif maqsura (ى): the ya shape of a top curl and wide sweeping bowl with no dots.

name: arabic-hamza
draw: Arabic hamza (ء): a small standalone hooked mark like a backwards c whose lower end flicks out into a short diagonal tail.

name: arabic-ta-marbuta
draw: Arabic ta marbuta (ة): a small closed round loop like heh with two dots side by side above it.

name: arabic-lam-alif
draw: Arabic lam alif ligature (لا): two tall strokes crossing in a V that join at a small loop at the base.

name: arabic-peh
draw: Arabic script letter peh (Persian, Urdu) (پ): the shallow canoe shaped bowl with three dots in a triangle below it.

name: arabic-tcheh
draw: Arabic script letter tcheh (Persian, Urdu) (چ): the folded top stroke and deep reversed C sweep of jim with three dots inside the curve.

name: arabic-jeh
draw: Arabic script letter jeh (Persian) (ژ): the comma like ra stroke with three dots in a triangle above it.

name: arabic-gaf
draw: Arabic script letter gaf (Persian, Urdu) (گ): a tall slanted stroke on the left joined to a flat base that curls up at the right, with a second short slanted bar parallel above the top.

name: hangul-giyeok
draw: Hangul consonant giyeok (ㄱ): a horizontal stroke across the top that turns sharply down at the right end into a vertical stroke.

name: hangul-digeut
draw: Hangul consonant digeut (ㄷ): a squared C of a top bar, a left upright and a bottom bar that reaches further right than the top.

name: hangul-rieul
draw: Hangul consonant rieul (ㄹ): three horizontal strokes joined by alternating right and left uprights, like a squared S.

name: hangul-bieup
draw: Hangul consonant bieup (ㅂ): two vertical stems joined by a middle crossbar and a closed bottom bar, like an open topped box with a shelf.

name: hangul-jieut
draw: Hangul consonant jieut (ㅈ): a horizontal top bar with an upside down V hanging from its centre.

name: hangul-chieut
draw: Hangul consonant chieut (ㅊ): the jieut shape of a top bar over an upside down V, with a short tick stroke above the bar.

name: hangul-kieuk
draw: Hangul consonant kieuk (ㅋ): the giyeok right angle with an extra short horizontal stroke through its middle.

name: hangul-pieup
draw: Hangul consonant pieup (ㅍ): a top bar and a longer bottom bar joined by two short vertical stems, like a small stool.

name: hangul-hieut
draw: Hangul consonant hieut (ㅎ): a short tick on top of a horizontal bar, sitting above a small circle.

name: hangul-ssanggiyeok
draw: Hangul double consonant ssanggiyeok (ㄲ): two small giyeok right angles side by side.

name: hangul-ssangdigeut
draw: Hangul double consonant ssangdigeut (ㄸ): two small squared C digeut shapes side by side.

name: hangul-ssangbieup
draw: Hangul double consonant ssangbieup (ㅃ): two small bieup boxes with crossbars side by side.

name: hangul-ssangsiot
draw: Hangul double consonant ssangsiot (ㅆ): two small upside down V shapes like tiny tents side by side.

name: hangul-ssangjieut
draw: Hangul double consonant ssangjieut (ㅉ): two small jieut shapes, each a top bar over an upside down V, side by side.

name: hangul-a
draw: Hangul vowel a (ㅏ): a tall vertical stroke with one short horizontal tick sticking out to the right at mid height.

name: hangul-ya
draw: Hangul vowel ya (ㅑ): a tall vertical stroke with two short horizontal ticks sticking out to the right.

name: hangul-eo
draw: Hangul vowel eo (ㅓ): a tall vertical stroke with one short horizontal tick sticking out to the left at mid height.

name: hangul-yeo
draw: Hangul vowel yeo (ㅕ): a tall vertical stroke with two short horizontal ticks sticking out to the left.

name: hangul-yo
draw: Hangul vowel yo (ㅛ): a long horizontal base bar with two short vertical ticks standing on it.

name: hangul-ae
draw: Hangul vowel ae (ㅐ): two tall vertical strokes side by side with one short tick running from the left stroke toward the right one.

name: hangul-e
draw: Hangul vowel e (ㅔ): two tall vertical strokes side by side with one short tick sticking out to the left of the left stroke.

name: hangul-yae
draw: Hangul vowel yae (ㅒ): two tall vertical strokes side by side with two short ticks running from the left stroke toward the right one.

name: hangul-ye
draw: Hangul vowel ye (ㅖ): two tall vertical strokes side by side with two short ticks sticking out to the left of the left stroke.

name: hangul-wa
draw: Hangul vowel wa (ㅘ): a short upright tick standing on a horizontal bar at the lower left, beside a tall vertical with a tick to the right.

name: hangul-wae
draw: Hangul vowel wae (ㅙ): a short upright tick on a horizontal bar at the lower left, beside two tall verticals with a tick between them.

name: hangul-oe
draw: Hangul vowel oe (ㅚ): a short upright tick standing on a horizontal bar at the lower left, beside a plain tall vertical stroke.

name: hangul-wo
draw: Hangul vowel wo (ㅝ): a horizontal bar with a short stem dropping below it at the lower left, beside a tall vertical with a tick to the left.

name: hangul-we
draw: Hangul vowel we (ㅞ): a horizontal bar with a short stem dropping below it, beside two tall verticals with a tick out to the left.

name: hangul-wi
draw: Hangul vowel wi (ㅟ): a horizontal bar with a short stem dropping below it at the lower left, beside a plain tall vertical stroke.

name: hangul-ui
draw: Hangul vowel ui (ㅢ): a plain horizontal bar at the lower left beside a plain tall vertical stroke on the right.

name: hiragana-i
draw: Hiragana i (い): two short near vertical strokes side by side, the left one longer with a small hook at its foot.

name: hiragana-u
draw: Hiragana u (う): a short dash on top above a stroke that arcs right and sweeps down into a hook to the lower left.

name: hiragana-e
draw: Hiragana e (え): a short dash on top above a zigzag that runs right, cuts diagonally down left, then ends in a long flat tail to the right.

name: hiragana-o
draw: Hiragana o (お): a horizontal bar crossed by a vertical stroke that loops into a round belly on the right, with a small dash at the upper right.

name: hiragana-ka
draw: Hiragana ka (か): an angular stroke like a 7 with a hooked foot crossed by a slanted downstroke, plus a separate short dash at the right.

name: hiragana-ki
draw: Hiragana ki (き): two horizontal bars crossed by a slanted stroke, with a separate open curve at the bottom.

name: hiragana-ke
draw: Hiragana ke (け): a tall curved upright on the left, and on the right a horizontal bar crossed by a long stroke curving down to the left.

name: hiragana-ko
draw: Hiragana ko (こ): two short curved horizontal strokes stacked, the top one ending in a small hook and the bottom one curving up at the right.

name: hiragana-sa
draw: Hiragana sa (さ): a horizontal bar crossed by a slanted stroke, above a separate open curve like a backwards c.

name: hiragana-shi
draw: Hiragana shi (し): a single long stroke that drops straight down and curves up to the right at the bottom like a hook.

name: hiragana-su
draw: Hiragana su (す): a horizontal bar crossed by a vertical stroke that makes a small loop before dropping into a tail.

name: hiragana-se
draw: Hiragana se (せ): a long horizontal bar crossed by a short right upright and a longer left upright that curves into a flat base.

name: hiragana-so
draw: Hiragana so (そ): a zigzag of a short dash, a diagonal, a long horizontal and a curved tail sweeping down and back to the right.

name: hiragana-ta
draw: Hiragana ta (た): a cross shaped stroke on the left beside two short horizontal strokes stacked on the right.

name: hiragana-chi
draw: Hiragana chi (ち): a horizontal bar crossed by a slanted stroke that bends into a rounded bowl opening to the left, like a 5.

name: hiragana-tsu
draw: Hiragana tsu (つ): a single wide arch that starts flat on the left, curves over at the right and sweeps down into a hook to the lower left.

name: hiragana-te
draw: Hiragana te (て): a horizontal stroke that folds back at the right end and curves down into a long c shape.

name: hiragana-to
draw: Hiragana to (と): a short slanted stroke above a second stroke that curves down and back to the right into a flat base.

name: hiragana-na
draw: Hiragana na (な): a cross shaped stroke with a short dash on the right, above a small loop at the lower right.

name: hiragana-ni
draw: Hiragana ni (に): a tall curved upright on the left beside two short horizontal strokes stacked on the right.

name: hiragana-nu
draw: Hiragana nu (ぬ): two crossing diagonal strokes forming an overlapping loop that ends in a small round curl at the lower right.

name: hiragana-ne
draw: Hiragana ne (ね): a tall vertical stroke on the left crossed by a zigzag that loops around to the right and ends in a small curl.

name: hiragana-no
draw: Hiragana no (の): a single spiral stroke starting at the centre that curves over the top and around, like a cursive @.

name: hiragana-ha
draw: Hiragana ha (は): a tall upright on the left, and on the right a horizontal bar crossed by a stroke ending in a small loop.

name: hiragana-hi
draw: Hiragana hi (ひ): a single stroke that starts with a short flick, dips into a deep round bowl and rises with a flick at the right.

name: hiragana-fu
draw: Hiragana fu (ふ): four small separate strokes: a top curve, a central hooked bowl and a dot on each side.

name: hiragana-he
draw: Hiragana he (へ): a single stroke rising to a short peak on the left and descending in a longer gentle slope to the right.

name: hiragana-ho
draw: Hiragana ho (ほ): a tall upright on the left, and on the right two horizontal bars crossed by a stroke ending in a small loop.

name: hiragana-ma
draw: Hiragana ma (ま): two horizontal bars crossed by a vertical stroke that ends in a small loop at the bottom.

name: hiragana-mi
draw: Hiragana mi (み): a stroke that zigzags into a loop at the lower left and sweeps right, crossed by a short slanted stroke at the right.
